verdict.truth_definition: 50 independent seeded applications of the frozen noise layer per cell (PREREGISTRATION.md section 5, addendum)

primary_lift.statement: Brier beats the population-marginal baseline by >= 25% relative, and beats k-NN
primary_lift.value_label: relative Brier lift over the marginal

correlation.statement: correlation between predicted probability and empirical 50-sample frequency >= 0.9 across all persona x item cells

knn_proximity.statement: how much of the model's advantage is over k-NN rather than over nothing
knn_proximity.reading: k-NN is a strong reference here: it sees the same 15 interview answers the encoder sees, and matches on them directly. The per-stratum split is the interesting part -- an encoder that only beat k-NN on items near the interview would be memorizing the interview rather than recovering a trait vector.

leakage.instruction: this flag is set by the grader and is NEVER cleared by it. The orchestrator investigates (PREREGISTRATION.md section 3, rule 5).

metric_definitions.brier: per cell, the mean over that item's own categories of (predicted - empirical 50-sample frequency)^2; reported as the mean over the 5,000 cells
metric_definitions.log_loss: per cell, -sum_c p_true,c log(max(p_pred,c, eps)) over the item's own categories, eps = 1e-06
metric_definitions.ece: 10 equal-width bins over every (cell, category) predicted probability, count-weighted absolute gap to the mean empirical frequency in the bin
metric_definitions.correlation: Pearson between predicted probability and empirical 50-sample frequency, pooled over every (cell, category) pair

model.label: CONFIRMATORY -- fused theta_hat@15 + zero-shot loadings + trained thresholds, posterior-integrated

knn.label: baseline 3 -- k-NN on the 15 interview answers, k = 40

model_plugin.label: EXPLORATORY -- the same predictor with the posterior collapsed to its mean

model_text_thresholds.label: EXPLORATORY -- item side fully zero-shot (thresholds from item text)

full_matrix_posterior.label: EXPLORATORY -- Gate 2 full-matrix theta with fitted holdout item parameters

dec_fused_encoder.label: EXPLORATORY -- decomposition: fused theta x encoder items (plug-in)

dec_fused_fitted.label: EXPLORATORY -- decomposition: fused theta x fitted items (plug-in)

dec_full_encoder.label: EXPLORATORY -- decomposition: full-matrix theta x encoder items (plug-in)

dec_full_fitted.label: EXPLORATORY -- decomposition: full-matrix theta x fitted items (plug-in)

oracle.label: EXPLORATORY -- the analytic post-noise distribution itself, the ceiling 50 samples allow

qwen_no_interview_baseline.note: the Qwen no-interview baseline runs on Leonardo; the grader accepts it as soon as the parsed file lands and grades without it until then

aggregate_check.what: population marginal per probe item: predicted vs the 50-sample truth
aggregate_check.resampling_unit: the 100 held-out personas, both sides resampled together

cross_tabs.what: population 2-way table per probe item pair, predicted vs the 50-sample truth
cross_tabs.conditional_independence: each persona's joint over two items is the product of their two per-cell distributions, on BOTH sides. Neither the predictor nor the 50 seeded sittings carry a within-person joint, so the assumption is shared and the comparison is fair -- but it is an assumption, and a real answer dependence beyond theta would not show up in either side of this plot

error_decomposition_2x2.label: EXPLORATORY
error_decomposition_2x2.what: 2x2 over {fused theta_hat@15 vs the Gate 2 full-matrix theta_holdout} x {encoder loadings + trained thresholds vs the fitted held-out item parameters}. Plug-in throughout, so the only things that move are theta_hat and the item block
error_decomposition_2x2.reading: positive numbers are damage: the first arm scores worse than the second

oracle_ceiling_and_noise_floor.label: EXPLORATORY
oracle_ceiling_and_noise_floor.what: the analytic post-noise distribution of every cell, graded against its own 50-sample estimate. This is the best score any predictor could get, and the gap to it is the yardstick's own noise
oracle_ceiling_and_noise_floor.analytic_noise_floor_definition: mean over cells of sum_c p(1-p) / (categories * 50)

posterior_vs_plug_in.label: EXPLORATORY
posterior_vs_plug_in.what: posterior-integrated vs plug-in, the same model otherwise
